title: AI Voices 每日精选
subtitle: 研究者公开观点、研究发布与重要讨论。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: @rasbt：Catching up on the 10 (!) open LLM architecture releases from the past month. Quite a lot happened in October. I guess w
items.abstract_or_text: Catching up on the 10 (!) open LLM architecture releases from the past month. Quite a lot happened in October. I guess we can call it "Open October"! 1. Kolibri-1 (78B): A notable model from Germany. Features classic Grouped Query Attention (GQA) and Sliding Window Attention (SWA) attention module. 2. Ling 3.1 Flash (560B): Uses Kimi Delta Attention and the eighth uses gated Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) inspired by DeepSeek. 3. Muse Spark Open (816B): Besides Musse Glimmer, the first major open weight release from Meta (since Llama). Uses classic GQA + SWA but adds a LatentMoE. 4. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (120B): Combines Mamba-2 layers with just eight attention layers. Also LatentMoE 5. Dory1.0 (4B): A looped transformer design. 6. Reflection Beam (501B): GQA+SWA architecture. 7. Recursive Flint (40B): Note that "Recursive" is the company name; the architecture is a fairly standard MoE with GQA and SWA. 8. MiniMax M3.1-Flash (428B): Uses their own MiniMax Sparse Attention module. 9. LFM3 (1.7B): Hybrid architecture that mixes short convolutions and attention. 10. Mistral Large 4 (1T) combines MLA with sparse attention. Will probably cover/discuss things in more depth in the coming weeks!
items.summary_zh: Sebastian Raschka 汇总过去一个月 10 个开放大模型的架构特征，覆盖 GQA、SWA、MLA、LatentMoE、Mamba-2、循环 Transformer 与稀疏注意力等设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 编辑判断：这是一份由研究者给出的高密度架构观察，可帮助读者比较近期开放模型的技术路线；具体模型特性仍应回到各模型发布材料核验。
items.abstract_zh: 回顾过去一个月发布的 10 个（！）开放大语言模型架构。十月发生了很多事；我想我们可以把它称为“开放十月”！1. Kolibri-1（78B）：一款值得关注的德国模型，采用经典的分组查询注意力（GQA）和滑动窗口注意力（SWA）模块。2. Ling 3.1 Flash（560B）：使用 Kimi Delta Attention，而第八个使用了受 DeepSeek 启发的门控多头潜在注意力（MLA）。3. Muse Spark Open（816B）：除 Musse Glimmer 外，这是 Meta 自 Llama 以来首次重要的开放权重发布。采用经典 GQA + SWA，但加入了 LatentMoE。4. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL（120B）：将 Mamba-2 层与仅八层注意力层结合，也采用 LatentMoE。5. Dory1.0（4B）：循环式 Transformer 设计。6. Reflection Beam（501B）：GQA+SWA 架构。7. Recursive Flint（40B）：注意，“Recursive”是公司名；该架构是相当标准的 MoE，使用 GQA 和 SWA。8. MiniMax M3.1-Flash（428B）：使用其自有的 MiniMax Sparse Attention 模块。9. LFM3（1.7B）：混合架构，结合短卷积和注意力。10. Mistral Large 4（1T）将 MLA 与稀疏注意力结合。未来几周可能会更深入地报道/讨论这些内容！

items.title: @AnthropicAI：New Anthropic research: progress on provable inference for large language models. Here, we introduce FlashProve. Buildin
items.abstract_or_text: New Anthropic research: progress on provable inference for large language models. Here, we introduce FlashProve. Building on established cryptographic techniques, FlashProve allows developers to verify whether a given response came from a given AI model. It’s substantially more efficient than prior open-source methods for doing so. These proofs have a range of applications. They can, for instance, make it harder for attackers to hijack a chat, or enable safety evaluators to verify that the model they’re testing is the same one being served to customers. Further progress in provable inference will likely be an important part of improving trust in AI deployment. To that end, we're open-sourcing FlashProve’s code.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布开源 FlashProve：基于既有密码学技术，为模型输出提供来源可验证证明，并称其效率高于先前开源方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该发布将模型身份与输出完整性问题转化为可部署的证明机制；安全评估和服务端模型审计或可受益，但性能与安全性仍应以代码和技术材料为准。
items.abstract_zh: Anthropic 的新研究：大语言模型可证明推理方面的进展。我们在此介绍 FlashProve。FlashProve 建立在既有密码学技术之上，允许开发者验证某个给定回答是否来自某个给定 AI 模型。它比先前用于此目的的开源方法高效得多。这些证明有多种应用。例如，它们可以让攻击者更难劫持一次聊天，或让安全评估者验证他们测试的模型与向客户提供服务的模型是同一个。可证明推理的进一步进展，可能是提升 AI 部署可信度的重要组成部分。因此，我们正在开源 FlashProve 的代码。

items.title: @allen_ai：Can LLMs track state changes over long texts—like an object changing hands or a variable reassignment? On our new StateB
items.abstract_or_text: Can LLMs track state changes over long texts—like an object changing hands or a variable reassignment? On our new StateBench eval, frontier models including GPT-6 Sol & Claude Opus 5.5 fell to 13% accuracy or lower on the hardest, longest problems. https://github.com/allenai/state-bench
items.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 StateBench，用于测试模型在长文本中追踪对象转手、变量重赋值等状态变化的能力；帖文称，前沿模型在最难、最长题目上的准确率降至 13% 或以下。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一个针对长上下文状态追踪的明确评测信号，并附有代码仓库；所述模型分数是发布方报告的结果，编辑判断其值得以独立复现进一步检验。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型能否在长文本中追踪状态变化——例如物体易手或变量重新赋值？在我们新的 StateBench 评测中，包括 GPT-6 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5 在内的前沿模型，在最难、最长的问题上准确率降至 13% 或更低。https://github.com/allenai/state-bench

items.title: @MistralAI：Mistral Large 4 joins the model lineup on Open Math OS. 1.05T open weights, 1M context, live today for approved teams. O
items.abstract_or_text: Mistral Large 4 joins the model lineup on Open Math OS. 1.05T open weights, 1M context, live today for approved teams. Open Math OS is a research workspace where mathematicians and AI agents work on shared projects, built only on open models so the community can inspect and run them, and with the community in control of its own data.
items.summary_zh: Mistral AI 宣布将 Mistral Large 4 接入 Open Math OS，并称该模型提供 1.05T 开放权重和 100 万上下文长度，已向获批团队开放。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该帖披露了一个大规模开放权重模型在数学协作工作区中的部署信息；模型能力、开放范围与可复现性仍需查阅项目的正式技术资料。
items.abstract_zh: Mistral Large 4 加入 Open Math OS 的模型阵容。1.05T 开放权重、100 万上下文，今日起向获批团队开放。Open Math OS 是一个研究工作区，数学家和 AI 智能体可在其中开展共享项目；它只使用开放模型，以便社区检查和运行，并由社区掌控自身数据。

items.title: @theobearman：Anthropic updated its S1 this morning. Notable additions re automated AI R&D and human oversight of it: "[...] our inter
items.abstract_or_text: Anthropic updated its S1 this morning. Notable additions re automated AI R&D and human oversight of it: "[...] our internal estimates and our expectations regarding future models, rather than our current models, indicate that we may imminently meet our Responsible Scaling Policy’s definition of 'dramatically accelerated progress attributable to AI.' We have not designated any of our current models as exceeding this threshold, and we continue to assess the underlying data. We are also evaluating the implications of meeting the AI research and development capability threshold and will release further reports in the future as we set forth in our Responsible Scaling Policy."
items.summary_zh: Theo Bearman 转引 Anthropic 更新 S1 后有关自动化 AI 研发与人工监督的表述：其对未来模型的内部估计可能很快满足“由 AI 导致的显著加速进展”定义，但尚未将当前模型认定为超过该阈值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该帖引用了与能力阈值和监督有关的具体原文，能推动对负责任扩展政策的专业讨论；这是转引信息，编辑判断应以 Anthropic 的原始 S1 文件为准。
items.abstract_zh: Anthropic 今早更新了其 S1。关于自动化 AI 研发及其人工监督，值得注意的新增内容是：“……我们基于内部估计以及对未来模型的预期，而不是基于当前模型，认为我们可能即将满足《负责任扩展政策》中‘由 AI 导致的显著加速进展’的定义。我们尚未将任何当前模型指定为超过这一阈值，并将继续评估其基础数据。我们也在评估达到 AI 研究与开发能力阈值的影响，并将按照《负责任扩展政策》的规定，在未来发布更多报告。”

items.title: @random_walker：As AI labs race toward Recursive Self Improvement, there’s a possibility that what they are actually racing toward is Re
items.abstract_or_text: As AI labs race toward Recursive Self Improvement, there’s a possibility that what they are actually racing toward is Recursive Self Extinction — of their business model. Here’s my reasoning. 1. Progress on verifiable tasks continues. In particular, improving the cost efficiency of existing capabilities is a highly verifiable task. For the past few years, cost per equivalent capability has dropped by at least 10x per year. 2. Progress on most unverifiable tasks remains frustratingly hard. AI inherits the same limitations (ambiguous success criteria, slow and noisy feedback) that limit human performance at tasks ranging from writing to governance. 3. RSI ends up being narrow. Even if some version of RSI is achieved, it results in an explosion in some dimensions (efficiency, verifiable tasks) while falling short of producing something that is superintelligent in any real sense. 4. More than one lab stays at the frontier. This means the market will remain competitive, and developers can’t charge high margins to compensate for rapidly falling inference prices. 5. Jevons’ paradox is not a magic bullet. There are very few applications that will consume so many tokens that they could generate the astronomical amounts of revenue implied by the labs’ valuations. 6. What about scientific research? Even if it’s true that AI could enable great scientific innovations, I don’t think AI companies will make much money off of that. 7. The one escape hatch is moving “up the stack”, transitioning from selling tokens to an enterprise software like model that relies on high switching costs.
items.summary_zh: Arvind Narayanan 提出一种作者观点：递归自我改进即便实现，也可能主要提升可验证任务与成本效率；若多家实验室持续竞争、推理价格快速下降，AI 实验室未必获得与估值匹配的利润。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一套清晰展开、可被反驳的产业经济论证，而非事实结论；它把能力进展、任务可验证性、竞争结构与商业化路径放在同一讨论框架中。
items.abstract_zh: 当 AI 实验室竞相追逐递归自我改进时，有一种可能是：它们实际竞相追逐的是其商业模式的递归自我毁灭。以下是我的理由。1. 在可验证任务上的进展持续存在。特别是，提高既有能力的成本效率是一项高度可验证的任务。过去几年中，等效能力的单位成本每年至少下降 10 倍。2. 在大多数不可验证任务上的进展仍然令人沮丧地困难。AI 继承了限制人类在从写作到治理等任务上表现的同样局限：成功标准模糊，反馈缓慢且噪声很大。3. RSI 最终会变得狭窄。即便某种形式的 RSI 得以实现，它也只会在某些维度上爆发式增长（效率、可验证任务），却仍不足以产生任何真正意义上的超智能。4. 不止一家实验室会保持在前沿。这意味着市场仍将竞争激烈，开发者无法收取高利润率来补偿快速下跌的推理价格。5. 杰文斯悖论不是灵丹妙药。能消耗如此多 token、以至于产生 AI 实验室估值所暗示的天文数字收入的应用非常少。6. 科学研究怎么办？即便 AI 能够带来伟大的科学创新是真的，我也不认为 AI 公司会从中赚到很多钱。7. 唯一的逃生舱口是“向上栈移动”，从出售 token 转向依赖高转换成本的企业软件式模式。

items.title: @axiommathai：We release the list "a hundred selected departures from publishing arguments" which contains substantial mathematical er
items.abstract_or_text: We release the list "a hundred selected departures from publishing arguments" which contains substantial mathematical errors - while the full errata list has many thousands of items. These are a direct byproduct of our formalization of Classification of Finite Simple Groups.
items.summary_zh: Axiom 发布一份“出版论证中的一百项精选偏差”清单，称其中列有实质性数学错误；其完整勘误清单包含数千项，均来自对有限单群分类的形式化工作。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该发布提供了形式化如何暴露既有数学论证问题的具体量级信息；编辑判断其价值在于可审计的勘误产物，具体错误与形式化范围仍需查看项目材料。
items.abstract_zh: 我们发布了“出版论证中的一百项精选偏差”清单，其中包含实质性的数学错误——而完整勘误清单有数千项。这些是我们对有限单群分类进行形式化的直接副产物。

items.title: @OpenAI：Two OpenAI team members worked with GPT-6 Astra to design a prototype device for talking to Codex in under a week, as a
items.abstract_or_text: Two OpenAI team members worked with GPT-6 Astra to design a prototype device for talking to Codex in under a week, as a side project. Astra designed the enclosure, circuit board, interface, and software. Getting it manufactured still required several rounds of review and iteration.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 称，两名团队成员借助 GPT-6 Astra 在一周内完成了一个与 Codex 对话的原型设备；模型参与设计外壳、电路板、界面和软件，制造环节仍经历多轮人工审查与迭代。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是包含任务范围和人工介入边界的工程案例，而非仅泛称效率提升；编辑判断它说明端到端原型可被加速，但尚不足以证明制造流程已自动化。
items.abstract_zh: 两名 OpenAI 团队成员把与 Codex 对话的原型设备作为一个业余项目，在不到一周内与 GPT-6 Astra 一起完成了设计。Astra 设计了外壳、电路板、界面和软件。要把它制造出来，仍需要经过数轮审查和迭代。

items.abstract_or_text: We @huggingface reproduced this paper!! It's built with ML Intern, an open-source harness to do AI research, train models, and more Model: https://huggingface.co/ML-Intern-lab/Qwen3.5-0.8B-weight-space-programming Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/ML-Intern-lab/weight-space-programming-demo

items.why_it_matters_zh: 帖文给出了可访问的模型和演示入口，使复现主张具备初步可核查性；原帖未说明评测方法或复现结果细节，编辑判断不宜据此推断性能结论。
items.abstract_zh: 我们在 Hugging Face 复现了这篇论文！！它使用 ML Intern 构建；ML Intern 是一个用于开展 AI 研究、训练模型等的开源工具框架。模型：https://huggingface.co/ML-Intern-lab/Qwen3.5-0.8B-weight-space-programming 演示：https://huggingface.co/spaces/ML-Intern-lab/weight-space-programming-demo

items.abstract_or_text: Recently, @MSFTResearch released a paper, LLM-as-JEV (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.02076 I am releasing the open-source code to replicate the paper and go beyond it. GitHub repo: https://github.com/Athe-kunal/llm-as-jev Blog Post: https://athe-kunal.github.io/llm-as-jev/ Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Athekunal/llm-jev-reason-long
items.summary_zh: Astarag Mohapatra 为 Microsoft Research 的 LLM-as-JEV 论文发布开源复现代码、博客和数据集，并称这些资源可用于复现与扩展该工作。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 代码库和数据集链接使该复现工作具备进一步审查与复跑的条件；“超越论文”的效果主张尚无候选文本中的实验细节支撑。
items.abstract_zh: 最近，Microsoft Research 发布了一篇论文 LLM-as-JEV（https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.02076）。我正在发布开源代码，用于复现这篇论文并在其基础上进一步推进。GitHub 仓库：https://github.com/Athe-kunal/llm-as-jev 博客文章：https://athe-kunal.github.io/llm-as-jev/ 数据集：https://huggingface.co/datasets/Athekunal/llm-jev-reason-long

review.note: 已按候选文本审阅；X 帖文仅来自 Grok 检索缓存。保留研究发布、可复查的开放资源与实质性观点，剔除营销、招聘、重复帖串和缺乏上下文的短帖。
